				scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_KIN
		}

			AND = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 2 } }
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_STRONGER
		}
	}

	}

		}

	}

			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_KIN
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 2 } }
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_STRONGER
		}
	}

	on_accept = {
		qpq_k_marcher_charge_seal_from_scopes_effect = yes
	}

	on_decline = {
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				title = qpq_msg_proposal_declined_title
				left_icon = scope:recipient
				custom_tooltip = qpq_msg_proposal_declined_tt
			}
		}
	}

	auto_accept = no

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
	}
}

##### Electoral Purchase (Catalogue A)
qpq_electoral_purchase_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_diplomacy
	hidden = yes
	icon = heir
	desc = qpq_electoral_purchase_interaction_desc
	send_name = qpq_send_pact
	popup_on_receive = yes
	pause_on_receive = yes
	ai_maybe = no
	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 3
	send_options_exclusive = no
	cooldown_against_recipient = { months = 6 }
	prompt = qpq_electoral_purchase_prompt

	is_shown = {
		exists = scope:actor.primary_title
		scope:actor.primary_title = { any_elector = { this = scope:recipient } }
		NOT = { scope:actor = scope:recipient }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

	populate_recipient_list = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_to_list = characters
			every_close_family_member = {
				limit = { is_adult = yes }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_courtier = {
				limit = { is_adult = yes }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
		}
	}

	category = interaction_category_diplomacy
	hidden = yes
	icon = secret

	send_name = qpq_send_pact
	popup_on_receive = yes
	pause_on_receive = yes
	ai_maybe = no
	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 3
	send_options_exclusive = no
	cooldown_against_recipient = { months = 6 }
	prompt = qpq_dossier_prompt

	is_shown = {
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

	populate_recipient_list = {
		scope:actor = {
			every_vassal = {
				limit = {
					is_landed = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				add_to_list = characters
			}
		}
	}

	has_valid_target_showing_failures_only = {
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:actor } }
	}

			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

			every_vassal = {
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }

					is_adult = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}

				add_to_list = characters

##### The Heir Question (Catalogue A)
qpq_heir_question_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_hostile
	hidden = yes
	icon = icon_scheme_murder
	desc = qpq_heir_question_interaction_desc
	send_name = qpq_send_pact
	popup_on_receive = yes
	pause_on_receive = yes
	ai_maybe = no
	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 3
	send_options_exclusive = no
	cooldown_against_recipient = { months = 6 }
	prompt = qpq_heir_question_prompt

	is_shown = {
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

	populate_recipient_list = {
		scope:actor = {
			every_child = {
				limit = { is_alive = yes }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = primary_heir }
				primary_heir = { add_to_list = characters }
			}
		}
	}

	has_valid_target_showing_failures_only = {
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
	}

	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_gold
		localization = qpq_offer_gold
		current_description = qpq_offer_gold_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
		is_valid = {
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_offer_need_gold
				scope:actor = { gold >= { value = qpq_heir_question_price_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_on_delivery
		localization = qpq_offer_on_delivery

		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_split

			always = yes
		}
	}

##### Snatch (Catalogue A)
qpq_snatch_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_hostile
	hidden = yes
	icon = prison
	desc = qpq_snatch_interaction_desc
	send_name = qpq_send_pact
	popup_on_receive = yes
	pause_on_receive = yes
	ai_maybe = no
	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 3
	send_options_exclusive = no
	cooldown_against_recipient = { months = 6 }
	prompt = qpq_snatch_prompt

	is_shown = {
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

	populate_recipient_list = {
		scope:actor = {
			every_vassal = {
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_courtier = {
				limit = {
					is_adult = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_relation = {
				type = rival
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
		}
	}

	has_valid_target_showing_failures_only = {
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:actor } NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
	}

	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_gold
		localization = qpq_offer_gold
		current_description = qpq_offer_gold_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
		is_valid = {
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_offer_need_gold
				scope:actor = { gold >= { value = qpq_snatch_price_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_on_delivery
		localization = qpq_offer_on_delivery
		current_description = qpq_offer_on_delivery_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes

##### Dispossession (Catalogue A)
qpq_dispossession_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_vassal
	hidden = yes
	icon = revoke_title
	desc = qpq_dispossession_interaction_desc
	send_name = qpq_send_pact
	popup_on_receive = yes
	pause_on_receive = yes
	ai_maybe = no
	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 3
	send_options_exclusive = no
	cooldown_against_recipient = { months = 6 }
	prompt = qpq_dispossession_prompt

	is_shown = {
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		scope:recipient = { any_vassal = { is_landed = yes } }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

	populate_recipient_list = {
		scope:recipient = {
			every_vassal = {
				limit = { is_landed = yes }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
		}
	}

	has_valid_target_showing_failures_only = {
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { liege ?= scope:recipient }
	}

	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_gold
		localization = qpq_offer_gold
		current_description = qpq_offer_gold_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
		is_valid = {
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_offer_need_gold
				scope:actor = { gold >= { value = qpq_dispossession_price_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_on_delivery
		localization = qpq_offer_on_delivery
		current_description = qpq_offer_on_delivery_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_split
		localization = qpq_offer_split
		current_description = qpq_offer_split_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_stipend
		localization = qpq_offer_stipend

			always = yes
		}
	}
	send_option = {

##### Marriage by Command (Catalogue A)
qpq_marriage_by_command_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_diplomacy
	hidden = yes
	icon = icon_marriage
	desc = qpq_marriage_by_command_interaction_desc
	send_name = qpq_send_pact
	popup_on_receive = yes
	pause_on_receive = yes
	ai_maybe = no
	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 3
	send_options_exclusive = no
	cooldown_against_recipient = { months = 6 }
	prompt = qpq_marriage_by_command_prompt

	is_shown = {
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		custom_description = {
			text = qpq_valid_can_marry
			scope:recipient = { can_marry_character_trigger = { CHARACTER = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		}
	}

	populate_recipient_list = {
		scope:actor = {
			every_courtier = {
				limit = { is_adult = yes is_married = no }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_close_family_member = {
				limit = { is_adult = yes is_married = no }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
		}
	}

	has_valid_target_showing_failures_only = {
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } is_married = no }
	}

	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_gold
		localization = qpq_offer_gold
		current_description = qpq_offer_gold_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
		is_valid = {
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_offer_need_gold
				scope:actor = { gold >= { value = qpq_marriage_by_command_price_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_on_delivery
		localization = qpq_offer_on_delivery
		current_description = qpq_offer_on_delivery_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
	send_option = {

		localization = qpq_offer_split
		current_description = qpq_offer_split_desc

			always = yes
		}
	}
	send_option = {

	pause_on_receive = yes

	ai_max_reply_days = 3

	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		exists = scope:actor.liege
		scope:actor.liege = scope:recipient.liege

			}
			AND = {

		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

				exists = scope:actor.house
				scope:recipient = {
					is_landed = yes
					OR = {
						any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
						any_close_family_member = {
							OR = {
								any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
								betrothed.house ?= scope:actor.house
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

						scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:actor.liege value >= 30 } }
					}
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_LIKED_ALLY
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:actor.liege
				OR = {
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:actor.liege }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:actor.liege }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:actor.liege }
					}
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_FRIEND
		}
	}

	on_accept = {
		qpq_k_coup_pact_seal_from_scopes_effect = yes
	}

	on_decline = {
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				title = qpq_msg_proposal_declined_title
				left_icon = scope:recipient
				custom_tooltip = qpq_msg_proposal_declined_tt
			}
		}
	}

	auto_accept = no

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
	}

		scope:recipient = {
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			is_landed = yes
		}

			}
		}
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }

		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

		scope:recipient = {
			every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {

					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }

			desc = QPQ_REASON_TRAIT_DECEITFUL
		}
		modifier = {
			add = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_TRAIT_ARBITRARY
		}
		modifier = {
			add = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_TRAIT_SCHEMER
		}
		modifier = {
			add = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_TRAIT_PARANOID
		}
		modifier = {
			add = qpq_proxy_war_goodwill_value
			desc = QPQ_REASON_GOODWILL
		}
		modifier = {
			add = 10
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_AMBITIOUS_CONQUEST
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -15
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_CRAVEN_WAR
		}
		modifier = {
			add = 10
			scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_HATES_TARGET
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -20
			scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_ALLIED_TO_TARGET
		}
		modifier = {
			add = qpq_proxy_war_goal_value
			desc = QPQ_REASON_GOALS
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_ALLY
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_KIN
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 2 } }
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_STRONGER
		}
	}

			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_DAMNABLE
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			qpq_ai_refuses_no_leverage_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_NO_LEVERAGE
		}
		modifier = {
			add = { value = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_TRAIT_HONEST
		}
		modifier = {
			add = { value = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = just }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_TRAIT_JUST
		}

			scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_TRAIT_DECEITFUL

			desc = QPQ_REASON_TRAIT_ARBITRARY

			desc = QPQ_REASON_TRAIT_SCHEMER

			scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_TRAIT_PARANOID
		}
		modifier = {
			add = qpq_partition_pact_goodwill_value
			desc = QPQ_REASON_GOODWILL
		}
		modifier = {
			add = qpq_partition_pact_goal_value
			desc = QPQ_REASON_GOALS
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_ALLY
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_KIN
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength add = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 2 } }
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_STRONGER
		}

		}

		base = 0
	}

			add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_TRAIT_PARANOID
		}

			add = qpq_faithless_ally_goodwill_value
			desc = QPQ_REASON_GOODWILL
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -15
			scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:secondary_recipient value >= 50 } }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_LOVES_TARGET
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -10
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_HONOUR_BOUND
		}
		modifier = {
			add = qpq_faithless_ally_goal_value
			desc = QPQ_REASON_GOALS
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_KIN
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				AND = {
						scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:secondary_recipient value >= 30 } }
					}
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_LIKED_ALLY
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				OR = {
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					}
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_FRIEND
		}
	}

			scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid }
			desc = QPQ_REASON_TRAIT_PARANOID
		}

			add = qpq_turncoat_goodwill_value
			desc = QPQ_REASON_GOODWILL
		}
		modifier = {
			add = qpq_turncoat_goal_value
			desc = QPQ_REASON_GOALS
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:recipient.liege
				scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:recipient.liege }
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_KIN
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:recipient.liege
				AND = {
						scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:recipient.liege }
						scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:recipient.liege value >= 30 } }
					}
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_LIKED_ALLY
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:recipient.liege
				OR = {
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:recipient.liege }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:recipient.liege }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:recipient.liege }
					}
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_FRIEND
		}
	}

		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

			is_independent_ruler = yes
			is_landed = yes
		}

			}
		}
	}

		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }

			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_KIN
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				AND = {
						scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:secondary_recipient value >= 30 } }
					}
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_LIKED_ALLY
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				OR = {
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					}
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_FRIEND
		}
	}

	on_accept = {
		qpq_k_extradition_seal_from_scopes_effect = yes
	}

	on_decline = {
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				title = qpq_msg_proposal_declined_title
				left_icon = scope:recipient
				custom_tooltip = qpq_msg_proposal_declined_tt
			}
		}
	}

	auto_accept = no

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
	}

				scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:recipient.liege }
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_KIN
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:recipient.liege
				AND = {
						scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:recipient.liege }
						scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:recipient.liege value >= 30 } }
					}
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_LIKED_ALLY
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -1000
			AND = {
				exists = scope:recipient.liege
				OR = {
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:recipient.liege }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:recipient.liege }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:recipient.liege }
					}
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_FRIEND
		}
	}

	on_accept = {
		qpq_k_buy_a_councillor_seal_from_scopes_effect = yes
	}

	on_decline = {
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				title = qpq_msg_proposal_declined_title
				left_icon = scope:recipient
				custom_tooltip = qpq_msg_proposal_declined_tt
			}
		}
	}

	auto_accept = no

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
	}

##### Excommunication for Hire (Catalogue D1)
qpq_excommunication_for_hire_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_religion
	hidden = yes
	icon = religious
	desc = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_interaction_desc
	send_name = qpq_send_pact
	popup_on_receive = yes
	pause_on_receive = yes
	ai_maybe = no
	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 3
	send_options_exclusive = no
	cooldown_against_recipient = { months = 6 }
	prompt = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_prompt

	is_shown = {
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
		scope:recipient.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

	populate_recipient_list = {
		scope:actor = {
			every_relation = {
				type = rival
				limit = {
					faith = scope:recipient.faith
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
				limit = {
					faith = scope:recipient.faith
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_vassal = {
				limit = {
					is_landed = yes
					faith = scope:recipient.faith
				}
				add_to_list = characters
			}
		}
	}

	has_valid_target_showing_failures_only = {
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { faith = scope:recipient.faith NOT = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
	}

	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_gold
		localization = qpq_offer_gold
		current_description = qpq_offer_gold_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
		is_valid = {
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_offer_need_gold
				scope:actor = { gold >= { value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_price_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			}
		}
	}

						scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					}
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_FRIEND
		}
	}

	on_accept = {
		qpq_k_excommunication_for_hire_seal_from_scopes_effect = yes
	}

	on_decline = {
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				title = qpq_msg_proposal_declined_title
				left_icon = scope:recipient
				custom_tooltip = qpq_msg_proposal_declined_tt
			}
		}
	}

	auto_accept = no

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
	}

		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }

		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

						scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
						scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					}
			}
			desc = QPQ_REASON_REFUSES_FRIEND
		}
	}

	on_accept = {
		qpq_k_bought_claim_seal_from_scopes_effect = yes
	}

	on_decline = {
		scope:actor = {
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = event_toast_effect_neutral
				title = qpq_msg_proposal_declined_title
				left_icon = scope:recipient
				custom_tooltip = qpq_msg_proposal_declined_tt
			}
		}
	}

	auto_accept = no

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
	}
}

	pause_on_receive = yes
	ai_maybe = no

	ai_max_reply_days = 3
	send_options_exclusive = no
	cooldown_against_recipient = { months = 6 }
	prompt = qpq_buy_a_bull_prompt

	is_shown = {
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

		scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
		has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

	populate_recipient_list = {
		scope:actor = { add_to_list = characters }

		scope:actor = {
			every_relation = {
				type = rival
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_vassal = {
				limit = {
					is_landed = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				add_to_list = characters
			}
		}
	}

	has_valid_target_showing_failures_only = {
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
	}

##### Fatwa for Hire (Catalogue D3)
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_religion
	hidden = yes
	icon = religious
	desc = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_interaction_desc
	send_name = qpq_send_pact
	popup_on_receive = yes
	pause_on_receive = yes
	ai_maybe = no
	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 3
	send_options_exclusive = no
	cooldown_against_recipient = { months = 6 }
	prompt = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_prompt

	is_shown = {
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			religion = religion:islam_religion
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				AND = {
					is_clergy = yes
					learning >= 15
				}
			}
		}
		scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

	populate_recipient_list = {
		scope:actor = {
			every_relation = {
				type = rival
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_vassal = {
				limit = {
					is_landed = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				add_to_list = characters
			}
		}
	}

	has_valid_target_showing_failures_only = {
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_landed = yes religion = religion:islam_religion }
	}

			always = yes
		}

			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_offer_need_gold
				scope:actor = { gold >= { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_price_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			}
		}
	}

		flag = qpq_o_on_delivery

##### Fund the Da'wa (Catalogue D3)
qpq_fund_the_dawa_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_religion
	hidden = yes
	icon = religious
	desc = qpq_fund_the_dawa_interaction_desc
	send_name = qpq_send_pact
	popup_on_receive = yes
	pause_on_receive = yes
	ai_maybe = no
	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 3
	send_options_exclusive = no
	cooldown_against_recipient = { months = 6 }
	prompt = qpq_fund_the_dawa_prompt

	is_shown = {
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			faith = scope:actor.faith
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				AND = { is_clergy = yes learning >= 12 }
			}
		}
		scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_shia_doctrine }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

	populate_recipient_list = {
		scope:actor = {
			every_relation = {
				type = rival
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_vassal = {
				limit = {
					is_landed = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				add_to_list = characters
			}
		}
	}

	has_valid_target_showing_failures_only = {
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_landed = yes NOT = { faith = scope:actor.faith } }
	}

	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_gold
		localization = qpq_offer_gold
		current_description = qpq_offer_gold_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
		is_valid = {
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_offer_need_gold
				scope:actor = { gold >= { value = qpq_fund_the_dawa_price_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_on_delivery
		localization = qpq_offer_on_delivery
		current_description = qpq_offer_on_delivery_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
	send_option = {

##### Crowning the Usurper (Catalogue D3)
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_religion
	hidden = yes
	icon = religious
	desc = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_interaction_desc
	send_name = qpq_send_pact
	popup_on_receive = yes
	pause_on_receive = yes
	ai_maybe = no

	ai_max_reply_days = 3
	send_options_exclusive = no
	cooldown_against_recipient = { months = 6 }

	is_shown = {
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

		scope:recipient.faith = faith:orthodox
		scope:actor = {
			is_independent_ruler = no
			top_liege = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_empire }
		}
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_gold
		localization = qpq_offer_gold
		current_description = qpq_offer_gold_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
		is_valid = {
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_offer_need_gold
				scope:actor = { gold >= { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_price_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_on_delivery
		localization = qpq_offer_on_delivery
		current_description = qpq_offer_on_delivery_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_split

##### Favourable Omens (Catalogue D3)
qpq_favourable_omens_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_religion
	hidden = yes
	icon = religious
	desc = qpq_favourable_omens_interaction_desc
	send_name = qpq_send_pact
	popup_on_receive = yes
	pause_on_receive = yes
	ai_maybe = no
	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 3
	send_options_exclusive = no
	cooldown_against_recipient = { months = 6 }
	prompt = qpq_favourable_omens_prompt

	is_shown = {
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			faith = scope:actor.faith
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				this = scope:actor.realm_priest
			}
		}
		scope:actor.religion = { is_in_family = rf_pagan }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

	populate_recipient_list = {
		scope:actor = { add_to_list = characters }

		scope:actor = {
			every_relation = {
				type = rival
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_vassal = {
				limit = {
					is_landed = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				add_to_list = characters
			}
		}
	}

	has_valid_target_showing_failures_only = {
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
	}

	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_gold
		localization = qpq_offer_gold
		current_description = qpq_offer_gold_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
		is_valid = {
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_offer_need_gold
				scope:actor = { gold >= { value = qpq_favourable_omens_price_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_on_delivery
		localization = qpq_offer_on_delivery
		current_description = qpq_offer_on_delivery_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
	}

			always = yes
		}
	}
	send_option = {

##### Temple Patronage (Catalogue D3)
qpq_temple_patronage_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_religion
	hidden = yes
	icon = religious
	desc = qpq_temple_patronage_interaction_desc
	send_name = qpq_send_pact
	popup_on_receive = yes
	pause_on_receive = yes
	ai_maybe = no
	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 3
	send_options_exclusive = no
	cooldown_against_recipient = { months = 6 }
	prompt = qpq_temple_patronage_prompt

	is_shown = {
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			faith = scope:actor.faith
			OR = {
				is_clergy = yes
				government_has_flag = government_is_theocracy
			}
		}
		NOT = { exists = scope:actor.faith.religious_head }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

	populate_recipient_list = {
		scope:actor = {
			every_relation = {
				type = rival
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
				add_to_list = characters
			}
			every_vassal = {
				limit = {
					is_landed = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				add_to_list = characters
			}
		}
	}

	has_valid_target_showing_failures_only = {
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
	}

	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_gold
		localization = qpq_offer_gold
		current_description = qpq_offer_gold_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
		is_valid = {
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_offer_need_gold
				scope:actor = { gold >= { value = qpq_temple_patronage_price_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_on_delivery
		localization = qpq_offer_on_delivery
		current_description = qpq_offer_on_delivery_desc
		is_shown = {

##### Join the War (Catalogue G)
qpq_join_war_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_diplomacy
	hidden = yes
	icon = declare_war_interaction
	desc = qpq_join_war_interaction_desc
	send_name = qpq_send_pact
	popup_on_receive = yes
	pause_on_receive = yes
	ai_maybe = no
	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 3
	send_options_exclusive = no
	cooldown_against_recipient = { months = 6 }
	prompt = qpq_join_war_prompt

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

	populate_recipient_list = {
		scope:actor = {
			every_character_war = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_attacker = scope:actor }
					primary_defender = { add_to_list = characters }
				}
				else = {
					primary_attacker = { add_to_list = characters }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	has_valid_target_showing_failures_only = {
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		NOT = { scope:secondary_recipient = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			NOT = { top_liege = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege }
		}
		scope:actor = {
			any_character_war = {
				qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient }
				NOT = { is_participant = scope:recipient }
			}
		}
	}

	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_gold
		localization = qpq_offer_gold
		current_description = qpq_offer_gold_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
		is_valid = {
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_offer_need_gold
				scope:actor = { gold >= { value = qpq_join_war_price_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_on_delivery
		localization = qpq_offer_on_delivery
		current_description = qpq_offer_on_delivery_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_split
		localization = qpq_offer_split
		current_description = qpq_offer_split_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_stipend

			always = yes
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_land
		localization = qpq_offer_land

		is_shown = {

		}
	}

##### Stay Out of the War (Catalogue G)
qpq_stay_out_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_diplomacy
	hidden = yes
	icon = icon_combat
	desc = qpq_stay_out_interaction_desc
	send_name = qpq_send_pact
	popup_on_receive = yes
	pause_on_receive = yes
	ai_maybe = no
	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 3
	send_options_exclusive = no
	cooldown_against_recipient = { months = 6 }
	prompt = qpq_stay_out_prompt

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
	}

	populate_recipient_list = {
		scope:actor = {
			every_character_war = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_attacker = scope:actor }
					primary_defender = { add_to_list = characters }
				}
				else = {
					primary_attacker = { add_to_list = characters }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	has_valid_target_showing_failures_only = {
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		NOT = { scope:secondary_recipient = scope:recipient }
		scope:actor = {
			any_character_war = {
				qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient }
				NOT = { is_participant = scope:recipient }
			}
		}
	}

	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_gold
		localization = qpq_offer_gold
		current_description = qpq_offer_gold_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
		is_valid = {
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_offer_need_gold
				scope:actor = { gold >= { value = qpq_stay_out_price_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_on_delivery
		localization = qpq_offer_on_delivery
		current_description = qpq_offer_on_delivery_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_split
		localization = qpq_offer_split
		current_description = qpq_offer_split_desc

			always = yes
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_stipend
		localization = qpq_offer_stipend
		current_description = qpq_offer_stipend_desc
		is_shown = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
	send_option = {
		flag = qpq_o_land
